plain: In the late 1940s, people reported glowing green fireballs, a bit like green meteors, along with UFOs near US nuclear sites. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, offers his own idea about them during a debate challenge with a UFO skeptic named Mick West, drawing on a work called UFOs and Nukes. Michels suggests that a large mother ship sat outside the atmosphere and that the green fireballs were connected to it, which, if true, would tie the fireballs and the nuclear-site sightings to a single watching craft.
